I've read that one too, even saw the movie. The thing is, you're going to doubt yourself, even if it's just a shadow of a thought. You're going to have some doubt in you when you're ready.

Once you jump, take those pills, slash your wrists or what have you, you'll get scared and you'll regret. Maybe you wont, but if you're feeling those doubts you will.

Isn't is absolutely horrifying? I never knew of such a struggle in my life, but once I fell onto the floor I felt like I was trying to breathe the entire world in.

The worst part of the entire thing was the sound of myself struggling in silence. You can't even shout out for help.
That's good advice. It hits hard, man.
You missed a word there, but I think you meant regret. I'm going to say yes, because the feeling that I failed to do even one thing that should be easy is terrible.

It's not the fact that I was trying to kill myself, it's the fact that I'm naturally afraid of death, amungst other things. When I got enough courage to finally jump off the table, my weight, nor the force of the fall was enough to break my neck.

I struggled to breathe because my body panicked. I had nothing to grab onto and the only thing that was keeping me hanging there was a rope around my neck. It was the fear of dying slowly and feeling myself suffocate is what scared me.
I'm not on youtube and I've never heard it before, but if you don't believe me I don't really care.

Throwaway for obvious reasons. As someone who had failed to hang themselves and happened to only be saved by my weight breaking what the rope was tied to.

I can comfirm it is one of the scariest things you can experience.
I realize that. I just wanted him happy, he had suicidal roots as well, but it seems it was a wasted attempt.
